messages:
leo (Docs): spotting a mismatch in the Console examples: the dashboard sample links to dash:v2 but the new templates are under dash:v3. screenshots render empty cost-by-trace.

nina (SRE): confirmed on staging. the tracing hook snippet also omitted KV cache propagation so trace joins fail for batched requests.

omar (Platform): quick fix: update snippet to call `tracer.forward(req)` and change template id to `dash:v3/cost-latency-join`. I'll push a tiny template alias so older links still resolve.

leo (Docs): i'll prepare a PR with the corrected node and python snippets and a short migration note. want both before we rerun screenshots.

ci-bot: PR opened: docs#764 "docs: fix tracing propagation + dashboard template id" by leo (Docs)

omar (Platform): added infra test (infra-tests#164) that asserts trace_id and kv keys survive proxying and batching.

nina (SRE): once merged i'll run the staging screenshot job and verify the p50/p95 alignment.

leo (Docs): merged and backported to v3. CHANGES.md updated with one-liner for support.

ci-bot: staging deploy succeeded (docs#764, infra-tests#164)

nina (SRE): screenshots look correct, metric joins match. closing this thread.
